flatPortraitHingeAssertion.result: failed outside its intended partially open posture
flatPortraitHingeAssertion.reason: This test requires panel tabs to stay at the physical hinge. A flat inner portrait display intentionally fills space above the real keyboard; result panes split at the midpoint. The 60.33-point tab move triggered the assertion. No product layout was changed in response. The same complete test passed in the actual partially open laptop posture.

limitations: Mac locked after automated checks; an additional manual visual pass on the conventional iPhone was unavailable. XCTest landscape attachments from this simulator show malformed crops and were not used as App Store assets.
